'''Agerin Minosh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. He resided on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he built and sold armor in a small shop with the other vendors at the spaceport. He wore [[Color/Legends|brown and silver]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Agerin Minosh appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Equipment Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Minosh was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
